profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Capital One

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Amazon Prime Air

* Team AWS Tech Lead
* Designed and led implementation of next-generation cloud services over the course of 2 years to an on-time delivery
* Ranked as top performer during year end reviews for two consecutive years
* Designed and developed new features for another team’s services in Prime Air to support on time launch of product
* Mentored junior engineers to develop software engineering best practices and design skills
* Supported operational health of services by being on-call and solving critical issues in a timely manner

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Alexa for Business

* Designed and executed load test for AWS service. Gave recommendations to help scale service
* Stabilized flakey canaries and integration tests to decrease operational load
* Identified and made changes needed to make service pipeline a continuous deployment pipeline

positions.title: Academic Tutor
positions.description: Assist students with assignments in math, physics, and computer science.

positions.title: Application Development Intern
positions.description:
Designed cross platform mobile application to scan barcodes on equipment.
Created front end application using UI5, utilizing HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and XML.
Implemented backend services to communicate with the front end with REST services using SAP ABAP and Java.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
Researched the usability of mobile devices in the airline industry, focusing on Network Operations by interviewing managers of each department
Implemented Kafka Logging with a team for an in-house application
Designed and developed a Java class to read from and write to a SQL server
